value.body: A procurement executive buys the raw materials, parts, goods or services a company needs. Employers include manufacturers, retailers, e-commerce firms, hospitals and service companies. A typical day involves handling purchase requests, getting and comparing quotes, placing orders and following up with suppliers on delivery and payment.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BBA, B.Com or B.Tech; MBA (Operations) for some roles

items.label: Common tools
items.value: ERP purchasing modules (SAP and similar), Excel, e-procurement portals

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually start as purchase or procurement executives or trainees in a company's purchasing team. Spreadsheet and ERP skills and a supply-chain or operations specialisation help when applying.

value.title: At a glance
items: The work is a mix of desk work and supplier calls, with some plant or vendor visits.
Procurement rules and approvals are strict in larger firms.
Next roles: senior buyer, category manager, procurement or supply-chain manager.
